title: Zura Bio discontinues tibulizumab in HS after Phase II trial failure
summary: The study evaluated 247 participants randomised across 150mg and 300mg tibulizumab arms or placebo.

title: Zura Bio Discontinues Hidradenitis Suppurativa Development After Phase 2 Tibulizumab Trial Misses Endpoints
summary: Zura Bio Limited (NASDAQ:ZURA) announced that its Phase 2 TibuSHIELD trial evaluating tibulizumab (ZB-106) in adults with moderate-to-severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) failed to meet its primary and key secondary efficacy endpoints. The biotechnology company said neither the 300 mg nor the 150 mg dose achieved the study’s primary endpoint of percentage change from baseline in abscess and inflammatory nodule (AN) count at Week 16.
